_what: Tools, agents and Marketplace configurations renamed so a device is never part of a tool's identity. Each key is a former id and each value its current id. The server and the computer program read this so a device app released before the rename, and installs saved before it, keep working. Every use of a former tool or agent id that reaches the server (an agent card, a take, a live connection naming it) is counted operator-wide as a former_id_used event (records/interactions.json), at most once per `note_every_minutes` per isolate. Once a tool or agent row has had no use for `quiet_days`, counted from `counted_since`, the service watch former-names-retire (src/service-watch.json) hands the operator's AIs one job to delete it, so no one has to remember. Configuration and placement rows are read from saved rows and shared packages, not from a device, so they are not counted and are removed by hand once no saved row names them.

operations._what: MCP operations merged into another: an AI or app that still calls the former name is answered by the current one. input_names renames the caller's arguments, input fills arguments it did not give, answer_names renames keys of the answer, and row_fills gives every row of a renamed list a field it lacks from another of its fields.
